name: the eti-case detector never matches
why: The finding then never stamps a cell: no menu row, no tint, no 📊 Findings entry. Must fail on the positive count test.

edits.find: test: cell => { const a = _findCellTitleAnatomy(cell); return !!a && a.etiCase.length > 0; },

name: the eti-case tint setting is ignored
why: sa_findings_tint_eti_case would then not turn the paint off. Must fail on the tint-setting test.

name: rule 2 (last word a lowercase keyword) is gone
why: "(Moonitor remix)", "(U.S. remix)" and "(7” version)" fall back to alternative titles, which is the pre-ETI.org behaviour. Must fail on the remix release's ETI section.

name: rule 3 (first word a capitalized keyword) is gone
why: "(Version 1)" is then neither ETI nor flagged. Must fail on the positive count test.

name: the keyword memo is never refreshed
why: A keyword list edited in ⚙️ Settings would not take effect until a reload. No fixture changes the setting within one page load (every spec seeds it before load), so this is invisible to the suite; a spec that edits sa_findings_eti_keywords through the settings dialog and re-renders would cover it.

name: styleTitleEti() is not called after a fetch
why: No title is styled after Show all. Must fail on the placement test.

edits.find:
// Green italic extra title information — same contract.
            styleTitleEti();

name: the ETI span takes the brackets in
why: "(single version)" would be green including its brackets, unlike .mb-credit-attr. Must fail on the placement test, which reads the characters around each span.

name: master rows are not styled
why: renderGroupedTable() re-renders clones of the master rows, so on a multi-table page every span vanishes on the first filter. Must fail on the re-render test.

name: _styleTitleEtiEl() is not idempotent
why: A page saved with spans would get a second span inside the first on Load from Disk. Must fail on the round-trip test.

name: the setting does not stop the styling pass
why: sa_enable_title_eti_style off would still write spans (and the CSS gate alone would hide them, so check the DOM). Must fail on the switched-off test.

name: the CSS rule ignores the setting
why: Spans restored from a page saved with the setting on would stay green after it was switched off. Must fail on the round-trip test's plain half.
